# Storage Hygiene Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Use superpowers:executing-plans for native execution. Owner already authorizes autonomous implementation.

**Goal:** Remove redundant generated files and bound future cache/test output growth.
**Architecture:** A dependency-free Node command recognizes only project-local generated output. npm pretest/prebuild run age/size trimming; explicit cleanup can clear all recognized output. Preserve the playable preview and one recovery bundle.
**Tech Stack:** Node22+, node:test, npm.
**Spec:** docs/STORAGE.md.

## Global Constraints

Do not remove source, Git history, unknown files, symlink targets, current preview or current recovery bundle. No background service. Stable output names; CI artifact retention seven days.

## Review Focus

Dry-run must not mutate; work symlink must be rejected; nested symlinks must survive; unknown/protected files can exceed budget without being deleted; absent work is harmless. Each is covered by real filesystem fixtures.

## Task: project-local cleanup

Files: scripts/clean.mjs, tests/clean.test.js, package.json, .npmrc, README.md, AGENTS.md, CURRENT.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml.

- [x] Write real temporary-directory tests for dry-run, explicit scope, age/budget trim, cache cap and symlink boundaries. Verify failing behavior before implementation.
- [x] Implement cleanWorkspace(root, options) and a fixed-project CLI with dry-run default, --apply and --trim. No caller-supplied CLI deletion root.
- [x] Add npm commands/hooks and local bounded cache; shorten artifact retention. Document commands and preservation policy.
- [x] Verify old bundle ancestry, remove redundant old archive and known generated output, retain current bundle/preview. Run complete tests, build and preview check. Measure before/after.
- [x] Review, commit and verify authorized pushes. Refresh the single existing recovery bundle and receipt, never add another archive.
